operatorIrVersions.compatibility: Existing canonical bytes, operator identifiers, schemas and versionless lookup APIs remain frozen.
Explicit graph version only; no automatic upgrade of existing graphs, generation substitution, model activation or quality qualification.

operatorExtensions.name: sqrt
operatorExtensions.shape: input shape and model generation preserved
operatorExtensions.layout: logical element order; materialized output with no input alias
operatorExtensions.numeric: Correctly rounded IEEE F32 square root; signed zero and positive infinity preserved; negative finite values, negative infinity and NaN produce canonical F32 NaN.
operatorExtensions.resourceFormula: For N output elements: 8*N checked logical work units, 8*N temporary payload bytes and 4*N output bytes; live input counted separately by the liveness schedule. Arithmetic-loop cancellation polls every 64 elements; input and output materialization are bounded by admitted tensor bytes.

operatorExtensions.name: erf
operatorExtensions.shape: input shape and model generation preserved
operatorExtensions.layout: logical element order; materialized output with no input alias
operatorExtensions.numeric: First-party bounded deterministic error function, finite F32 envelope at most 2 ULP; odd signed-zero-preserving evaluation, infinities map to signed one and NaN to canonical F32 NaN. Ordered integrated Taylor series with 24 fixed updates for abs(x)<=1, bounded normal-tail evaluation for 1<abs(x)<4, signed one for abs(x)>=4.
operatorExtensions.resourceFormula: For N output elements: 896*N checked logical work units, 8*N temporary payload bytes and 4*N output bytes; live input counted separately by the liveness schedule. Arithmetic-loop cancellation polls every 64 elements; input and output materialization are bounded by admitted tensor bytes.

contracts.invariant: One immutable package root binds weights, preprocessing, operator graph, numeric policy, resource envelope, license, and qualification evidence.
Every operator has typed shape/dtype/layout/alias/numeric semantics, scalar oracle, resource formula, and stable versioned ID.
Execution uses a deterministic shape-specialized graph and memory plan with hard resource and cancellation boundaries.
Only a valid output root and execution receipt can become model-derived evidence.
Scalar, tiled, SIMD, fused, parallel, and quantized implementations are interchangeable only within their declared numeric envelope.
Quantization creates a new package generation and requires tensor plus event-level quality evidence.
Accelerators have no credentials, canonical-ledger mutation, or effect authority and cannot be a correctness dependency.
Foreign model runtimes are pinned differential oracles absent from production closure and effect paths.
